name: Enable Feature
description: The change makes a new product-facing capability possible.

name: Improve Maintainability
description: The change makes future changes easier without altering behavior.

name: Reduce Coupling
description: The change lowers how much one part of the system depends on another's internals.

name: Improve Testability
description: The change makes the code easier to exercise and verify in tests.

name: Improve Extensibility
description: The change makes it easier to add new variants/behavior later.

name: Improve Performance
description: The change reduces resource usage or latency.

name: Improve Security
description: The change closes a vulnerability or strengthens a security control.

name: Support New Requirement
description: The change adapts existing code to satisfy a new requirement.

name: Remove Technical Debt
description: The change cleans up a known shortcut or accumulated cost from prior work.

name: Prepare for Future Change
description: The change lays groundwork for an anticipated future change.

name: Enforce Architectural Boundary
description: The change tightens or restores an intended architectural separation.

name: Migrate Technology
description: The change replaces one technology/library/framework usage with another.

name: Improve Reliability
description: The change makes the system more resilient to failure conditions.
